title: Adventures of the Gummi Bears
blurb: A small colony of Gummi Bears keeps an old magic recipe safe while ogres and a nosy knight keep wandering into the forest.

title: DuckTales
blurb: Scrooge McDuck would rather count gold than babysit, until Huey, Dewey, and Louie turn his fortune into a series of treasure hunts.

title: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh
blurb: In the Hundred Acre Wood, Pooh, Piglet, Tigger, and the rest turn tiny problems into a whole afternoon.

title: Chip 'n Dale: Rescue Rangers
blurb: Chip and Dale run a detective crew for cases that happen underfoot, with Gadget inventing the getaway plan.

title: TaleSpin
blurb: Baloo and Kit fly cargo out of Cape Suzette for Higher for Hire, usually with air pirates somewhere in the clouds.

title: Darkwing Duck
blurb: By day Drake Mallard is a suburban dad. By night he is St. Canard's loudest masked crimefighter, with Launchpad at the controls.

title: Goof Troop
blurb: Goofy and his son Max move to Spoonerville and end up next door to Pete, which is plenty of plot for any afternoon.

title: Gargoyles
blurb: Goliath's clan wakes from a long stone sleep atop a Manhattan skyscraper and tries to protect a city that does not quite believe in them.

title: DuckTales (2017)
blurb: A later take on Scrooge's family expeditions, with the triplets, Webby, and Launchpad chasing secrets Scrooge would rather keep buried.

title: The Flintstones
blurb: Fred Flintstone clocks out of the quarry in Bedrock and still finds a way to turn a quiet night with Wilma, Barney, and Betty into a scheme.

title: The Jetsons
blurb: George Jetson pushes buttons at Spacely Space Sprockets, then comes home to Jane, Judy, Elroy, and a dog named Astro who still needs a walk.

title: Scooby-Doo, Where Are You!
blurb: Scooby, Shaggy, Fred, Daphne, and Velma pile into the Mystery Machine and follow a spooky clue until the mask comes off.

title: The Smurfs
blurb: Papa Smurf keeps the village one step ahead of Gargamel, while Smurfette, Brainy, and the rest turn a tiny mushroom town into a full adventure.

title: Inspector Gadget
blurb: Inspector Gadget arrives with a trench coat full of gadgets and the wrong theory. Penny and Brain quietly solve the case before Dr. Claw gets away.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987)
blurb: Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello, and Raphael train under Splinter in the sewers and come up for pizza, April O'Neil, and another round with Shredder.

title: Garfield and Friends
blurb: Garfield would rather nap and eat than chase Monday, but Jon, Odie, and the neighbors keep handing him a reason to get off the table.

title: Tiny Toon Adventures
blurb: Buster, Babs, and the Acme Acres class study under the classic Looney Tunes and still treat the lesson like a chase scene.

title: Rugrats
blurb: Tommy Pickles leads Chuckie, Phil, Lil, and Angelica through adventures that look ordinary from adult height and enormous from the floor.

title: The Little Mermaid (Series)
blurb: Ariel explores Atlantica with Flounder and Sebastian, collecting stories from the surface world while King Triton tries to keep the tide calm.

title: Batman: The Animated Series
blurb: Bruce Wayne keeps a quieter face in Gotham while Batman, Robin, and Batgirl work the night shift against the Joker, Harley Quinn, and the rest of the rogues.

title: X-Men: The Animated Series
blurb: Professor Xavier's team, from Cyclops and Storm to Wolverine and Rogue, protects a world that is still deciding how it feels about mutants.

title: Animaniacs
blurb: Yakko, Wakko, and Dot escape the water tower for a song, a history lesson, or a visit from Pinky and the Brain, who are still planning to take over the world.

title: Spider-Man: The Animated Series
blurb: Peter Parker balances the Daily Bugle, Mary Jane, and a city that needs Spider-Man more often than it thanks him.

title: Chhota Bheem
blurb: Bheem, Chutki, Raju, and Jaggu look after Dholakpur on Pogo. This page is for finding a legal copy, not for playing the series.

title: Little Krishna
blurb: Little Krishna follows Krishna's childhood in Vrindavan, a Nickelodeon India series. Use the links here to look for an official copy.

title: Roll No. 21
blurb: Kris attends school as roll number 21 while Principal Kanishk schemes, a Cartoon Network India original. These links only help you find it legally.

title: Mighty Raju
blurb: Raju, Bheem's friend from Dholakpur, gets a superhero turn that premiered on Pogo. This page lists store and library searches, not a stream.

title: Motu Patlu
blurb: Motu and Patlu tumble through Furfuri Nagar on Nickelodeon, usually one samosa ahead of trouble. Look up a legal copy from the links below.

title: Vir: The Robot Boy
blurb: Dr. Prem Sahay's robot boy Vir started on Hungama TV. This page points at official store and library searches and does not host episodes.

title: Pakdam Pakdai
blurb: Doggy Don chases Colonel, Chhotu, and Motu in this Indian kids' cartoon. The buttons on this page are legal places to look, not a player.

title: Tom and Jerry
blurb: Tom the cat and Jerry the mouse chase each other through a cartoon that ran for years on Cartoon Network India. Find a legal copy from the links here.

title: Doraemon
blurb: Doraemon the robot cat pulls gadgets from his pocket for Nobita. Hindi dubs of the series were staples on Hungama and Disney Channel India.

title: Ninja Hattori
blurb: Hattori the young ninja helps Kenichi while Kemumaki interferes. The series became a Nickelodeon India favorite and later a new Indian-made run.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
blurb: Prince Adam becomes He-Man to defend Eternia from Skeletor. The 1980s series was a Hindi-dubbed afternoon cartoon for a generation in India.

title: Perman
blurb: Mitsuo becomes Perman, a kid superhero with a copy-robot and a strict bird partner. Nickelodeon India ran the Hindi dub of this Fujiko series.

title: The Transformers
blurb: Optimus Prime and the Autobots face Megatron in the 1984 series. It circulated in India as a dubbed cartoon long before later Transformers shows.

title: ThunderCats
blurb: Lion-O and the ThunderCats guard the Eye of Thundera from Mumm-Ra. The 1985 series was one of the dubbed action cartoons kids in India rewatched.

title: Kiteretsu
blurb: Inventor kid Kiteretsu and his robot Korosuke stumble through experiments. Hungama TV added the Hindi dub to its comedy block in 2007.

title: Dragon Ball Z
blurb: Goku, Gohan, and Vegeta fight through the Dragon Ball Z sagas. The Hindi dub on Cartoon Network India is the version many people still search for.

title: The Jungle Book (1989)
blurb: Mowgli grows up with Baloo and Bagheera in the 1989 Japanese series, a Hindi-dubbed favorite on Indian television. This page does not play it.

title: Captain Planet and the Planeteers
blurb: Five Planeteers combine their rings to call Captain Planet. The early-90s series was part of the dubbed cartoon lineup kids in India grew up on.

title: Shin-chan
blurb: Shin-chan troubles his parents, Misae and Hiroshi, in Crayon Shin-chan. The Hindi dub ran for years on Hungama TV.

title: SWAT Kats: The Radical Squadron
blurb: T-Bone and Razor pilot the Turbokat as the SWAT Kats. The short 1993 run still shows up in memories of dubbed action cartoons in India.

title: Dexter's Laboratory
blurb: Boy genius Dexter hides a secret lab from his sister Dee Dee. It was a Cartoon Network India pillar from the channel's early years.

title: Hey Arnold!
blurb: Arnold Shortman navigates boarding-house life with Gerald and Helga. Nickelodeon India carried the city kid series alongside its later originals.

title: Johnny Bravo
blurb: Johnny Bravo's sunglasses and hairdo get him nowhere, which was half the joke on Cartoon Network India. Search links here stay on official stores.

title: Pokémon
blurb: Ash and Pikachu travel with Misty and Brock while Team Rocket interrupts. The Hindi dub was one of the most searched cartoons on Indian kids' TV.

title: Recess
blurb: T.J. and the gang treat the playground as its own country. Disney Channel India ran this 1997 series with the rest of its afternoon lineup.

title: The Powerpuff Girls
blurb: Blossom, Bubbles, and Buttercup save Townsville before bedtime. Cartoon Network India kept the 1998 series in heavy rotation.

title: Oggy and the Cockroaches
blurb: Oggy the cat loses every quiet afternoon to Joey, Dee Dee, and Marky. Cartoon Network India made the nearly wordless chases a daily habit.

title: Courage the Cowardly Dog
blurb: Courage guards Muriel and Eustace in Nowhere from whatever knocks. The series was a Cartoon Network India scare-comedy staple.

title: Ed, Edd n Eddy
blurb: Ed, Double D, and Eddy chase jawbreakers and schemes through the cul-de-sac. Cartoon Network India ran it for years.

title: Digimon Adventure
blurb: Tai and Agumon lead the DigiDestined after summer camp turns into the Digital World. The dubbed series sat beside Pokémon in Indian kids' TV memory.

title: SpongeBob SquarePants
blurb: SpongeBob flips Krabby Patties in Bikini Bottom with Patrick and Squidward nearby. Nickelodeon India kept the series on the schedule for years.

title: Dora the Explorer
blurb: Dora and Boots ask viewers for help before Swiper can grab the next item. Nickelodeon India used it as a preschool landmark.

title: Beyblade
blurb: Tyson and the Bladebreakers spin beyblades against teams from around the world. The Hindi dub was a Cartoon Network and Hungama-era craze in India.

title: The Fairly OddParents
blurb: Timmy Turner wishes his way out of trouble with fairy godparents Cosmo and Wanda. Nickelodeon India ran the series through the 2000s.

title: Samurai Jack
blurb: Samurai Jack walks a future ruled by Aku, trying to find a way home. Cartoon Network India treated the quiet, stylized episodes as event television.

title: The Proud Family
blurb: Penny Proud balances school, friends, and a very loud family. Disney Channel India carried the 2001 series with its other American imports.

title: Kim Possible
blurb: Kim Possible saves the world between cheer practice, with Ron Stoppable and Rufus along. It was a Disney Channel India action comedy.

title: Codename: Kids Next Door
blurb: Sector V fights adult tyranny from a tree house. Cartoon Network India ran Codename: Kids Next Door through the after-school block.

title: The Adventures of Jimmy Neutron, Boy Genius
blurb: Jimmy Neutron invents first and thinks later, with Goddard, Carl, and Sheen nearby. Nickelodeon India aired the boy-genius series.

title: The Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy
blurb: Billy and Mandy keep the Grim Reaper as a best friend after winning a bet. Cartoon Network India paired it with its other macabre comedies.

title: Lilo & Stitch: The Series
blurb: Lilo and Stitch hunt experiments loose on Kauai. The series followed the film onto Disney Channel India.

title: Teen Titans
blurb: Robin, Starfire, Beast Boy, Raven, and Cyborg share a tower and a villain list. Cartoon Network India ran the 2003 team series.

title: Danny Phantom
blurb: Danny Fenton fights ghosts while trying to finish high school. Nickelodeon India carried the half-ghost superhero series.

title: Winx Club
blurb: Bloom and the Winx fairies train at Alfea. The series reached Indian kids' channels, including Nickelodeon, during the 2000s.

title: American Dragon: Jake Long
blurb: Jake Long learns to be the American Dragon while protecting magical creatures in New York. Disney Channel India aired the series.

title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
blurb: Aang, the last airbender, travels with Katara, Sokka, and later Toph. Nickelodeon India introduced a lot of viewers to the series.

title: Ben 10
blurb: Ben Tennyson finds the Omnitrix on a road trip with Gwen and Grandpa Max. Cartoon Network India turned the 2005 series into a phenomenon.

title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse
blurb: Mickey invites younger viewers into the Clubhouse with Minnie, Donald, Goofy, and Pluto. Disney Channel India ran it as a preschool show.

title: Phineas and Ferb
blurb: Phineas and Ferb build something enormous every summer day while Perry stops Dr. Doofenshmirtz. Disney Channel India kept the series in prime slots.

title: Adventure Time
blurb: Finn and Jake adventure through Ooo. Cartoon Network India carried the series for viewers who had grown up on the channel's earlier comedies.

title: The Amazing World of Gumball
blurb: Gumball and Darwin survive middle school in Elmore. Cartoon Network India made the series one of its later hits.

title: Gravity Falls
blurb: Dipper and Mabel spend a summer with Grunkle Stan in a town full of secrets. Disney Channel India aired the mystery series.

title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir
blurb: Marinette and Adrien become Ladybug and Cat Noir over Paris. Disney Channel India was one of the places the Hindi and English feeds reached kids.
